column1: # rg-command-cases.tsv — the ONE case table for "is this one plain ripgrep command?" (#513, #511/#514).
# Two implementations enforce that rule: the PreToolUse hook (rg-only-hook.sh) decides what the rg arm may
# EXECUTE, and Ap6RunReader.IsRgCommand decides what a run is JUDGED as. Where the two disagree, a command
# either runs and is then scored as clean, or is refused and still counted against the arm — three such
# divergences were measured before this file existed. Prose cannot hold them together, so both read this
# table: rg-only-hook.test.sh replays every row through the real hook, Ap6RunReaderTests through
# IsRgCommand. Add a case here, in one place, and both sides are held to it.
# Format: <command><TAB>allow|deny. Lines starting with '#' and empty lines are ignored. Fields are split on
# the FIRST tab, so an empty command (first field empty) is a legal row.
# Escapes, decoded identically on both sides — and ONLY these, so that an unknown escape is a test failure
# Payload-level cases (a hook payload that is not JSON, or that carries no command at all) have no command
# text and cannot live in this table; rg-only-hook.test.sh asserts them separately, and the JsonElement
# overload of IsRgCommand is tested for the same shapes.
# ---------- allowed: one plain rg call, however it names rg ----------
# ---------- allowed: shell metacharacters that are QUOTED are pattern text, not shell (#514) ----------
# The quote-blind rule this replaces refused these and cost the arm turns for its own alternations, which
# inflated toolCallCount in the arm the measurement compares against.
# PARSE-ERROR is ordinary text; the old hook refused it because it scanned for its own sentinel (#514).
# 0x0B/0x0C separate words for `[[:space:]]`, which is the word boundary both sides now use.
# U+00A0 is not a space, so the command word is literally "<nbsp>rg" — which is not ripgrep.
# ---------- denied: a second, unvetted command behind the rg one ----------
# ---------- denied: rg flags that run a program (#514, blocker 3) ----------
